header.cleanBody: Either by paying one cost during the Flash Timing of Either Attack Step, or when this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can flip it. When you do, this Reborn Brave can either refresh and brave to a Spirit you control, or remain in Spirit condition by putting a core from your Reserve/Spirit onto it.
